description: Turns what a Godot export leaves into editable text: compiled GDScript (.gdc: Godot 3 bytecode v10–13 and Godot 4.3+ binary tokens v100/v101, zstd-compressed or not) back to .gd with indentation, binary resources and scenes (RSRC/RSCC .scn/.res, also under .godot/exported with their .remap targets) to .tscn/.tres with ext/sub resources, node tree, groups, instances and signal connections, and project.binary to project.godot. Give the folder re_archive extracted from the .pck. Names, constants and structure are exact; comments and the original formatting are not in the export. Encrypted scripts (.gde) are reported, never decrypted. Imported resources go back to the format they came from: .ctex/.stex textures to PNG (stored PNG copied, lossless WebP decoded to PNG, lossy WebP kept as .webp; raw 8-bit, DXT1/5, RGTC and ETC/ETC2 decoded; Basis Universal, ASTC and BPTC are reported and left), .sample to WAV (PCM, IMA ADPCM and QOA decoded, loop points kept), .oggvorbisstr/.oggstr to OGG, .mp3str to MP3, and .translation to CSV for the keys that can be matched (keys are hashed: give keys, or run on the folder so scripts and scenes supply them; texts without a key are listed apart). In a folder, .import files give every converted file its original name and place, and are written beside it so Godot keeps the uids the scenes use. Ren'Py compiled scripts: a .rpyc/.rpymc file or a folder is written back as .rpy text (Ren'Py 6.99-8.x: labels, dialogue, menus, screens, ATL, translations); the pickle is read as data and never executed; comments are gone, and a node class the printer does not know becomes a comment line and is counted. GameMaker data.win/game.unx/game.ios/game.droid (or its folder): GML bytecode 14-17 becomes scripts/<name>.gml, objects/<object>/<Event>_<n>.gml and rooms/<room>/RoomCreationCode.gml; an entry the decompiler is not sure about is written as GML assembly with the reason instead of guessed code; YYC builds (compiled to native) are reported. Encrypted files are reported, never decrypted.

asm.description: GameMaker: also write GML assembly (.asm) for every entry; it is always written for an entry that is not decompiled.

keys.description: Candidate translation keys for .translation files (their keys are stored as hashes). In folder mode keys are also taken from the scripts, scenes and CSV files found.

limit.description: Max files, or for GameMaker max code entries (default 2000 files; all code entries).

match.description: GameMaker: only code entries whose name or output path matches (substring, glob or /regex/).

path.description: A .gdc/.scn/.res/project.binary, .ctex, .sample, .translation, .rpyc or data.win file, or an extracted folder.

name: re_decode
title: Decode Godot binary exports
